cases.name: locked-installer-entry

observedHostedFailure.result: mise rejected the repository configuration as untrusted before the installer ran.

decision: The revised workflow resolves the installed executable with mise which node before sudo. The resolved executable starts Node24 and the locked installer under the same local untrusted-home control.
limits: The --help command admits CLI arguments and starts the locked JavaScript entry. It does not install Chrome or Linux dependencies.
The local control runs on macOS arm64 without sudo. Actual hosted Linux root installation remains not-run for the revised workflow.
The hosted rerun must prove Chrome installation and then do the rendered and publication checks for the pushed candidate.
